0.description: B2B and corporate event organizers booking recurring conferences, offsites, and team celebrations with steady volume and high lifetime value.
strategies: Deploy dedicated account management and B2B corporate billing agreements
Offer multi-event volume rebates and annual retainer packages
Automate recurring vendor invoicing and bulk caterer coordination
Deliver priority customer support SLA (< 15 min response time)

1.description: Previously engaged customers with no recent inquiries or bookings for 100+ days and declining platform visits.
strategies: Launch automated WhatsApp re-engagement with 'Planning your next celebration?' touchpoint
Offer limited-time reactivation perks (₹5,000 venue credit)
Send seasonal celebration calendars (Diwali, New Year, Wedding Muhurat dates)
Gather quick feedback survey to identify drop-off pain points

2.description: Premium customers planning grand celebrations, destination weddings, and luxury banquets. Insensitive to discounts, high conversion when provided bespoke concierge.
strategies: Assign dedicated VIP Wedding Concierge & private venue tours in Lonavala/Alibaug
Offer premium curated vendor packages (luxury decorators, celebrity photographers)
Provide priority calendar hold on top-tier 5-star banquet lawns
Do not offer blanket discount codes; focus on exclusive value-add amenities

3.description: Regular individuals planning anniversaries, engagements, and local family functions. Steady engagement and healthy booking conversion.
strategies: Showcase curated local verified vendors in Mumbai, Pune, and Nashik
Recommend customizable catering and photography add-ons
Offer flexible EMI or staged milestone payment plans
Encourage reviews and referral bonuses for upcoming family celebrations
